units.source_text: 那些奴隶的洞穴，现在并排在道路的左侧……

en.t: Those slaves' holes were now lined up along the left side of the road...

units.source_text: 到处都是拉大网篮的沟坎，前面埋着一个个磨秃了的草袋子，告诉人们那里有洞穴……

en.t: Everywhere there were ruts and ditches for dragging the big net baskets, and in front of them worn-down straw bags had been buried one by one to tell people there were holes there...

units.source_text: 就是看一眼你也会觉得难受。

en.t: Even one glance would make you feel sick at heart.

units.source_text: 草袋子上有不吊绳梯的，也有吊着绳梯的，似乎还是吊着绳梯的居多。

en.t: Some of the straw bags had no rope ladders hanging from them, while others did, and it seemed the ones with rope ladders were still the majority.

units.source_text: 看来连逃跑意愿都已丧失的家伙，还不在少数呢。

en.t: It looked as though there were still quite a few who had even lost the will to escape.
